vfp_station_desc: A runic cauldron for preparing special dishes. Has a built-in fire: add wood like at a campfire.
vfp_fermentbarrel_desc: Runic Cauldron upgrade. Raises the cooking station level to 2. Place near the Runic Cauldron.
vfp_runedryingrack_desc: Runic Cauldron upgrade. Raises the cooking station level to 3. Place near the Runic Cauldron.
vfp_berrymash_desc: Sweet, sticky and gone in no time.
vfp_yellowmushroomsoup_desc: Yellow. Warm. Hopefully the right mushrooms.
vfp_wolfherbroast_desc: The wolf would have eaten you too.
vfp_goldenbarleyporridge_desc: Like sunrise on the Plains. With a spoon.
vfp_magicmushroomcream_desc: Shimmers faintly. Don't stare too long.
vfp_emberherbsoup_desc: Blow on it first. Then blow again.
vfp_swampfishstew_desc: Smells of the bog. Tastes like it too.
vfp_anglermistsoup_desc: Glows in the bowl. And later in your belly.
vfp_royalmistragout_desc: Fit for a jarl. Or a hungry viking.
vfp_asksvinemberfeast_desc: A feast of ash and fire.
vfp_northernoatporridge_desc: Warms you inside when everything outside freezes.
vfp_icedistillery_desc: Runic Cauldron upgrade. Raises the cooking station level to 4 and unlocks the dishes of the North. Place near the Runic Cauldron.
vfp_ticksud_desc: Better not ask what's in it.
vfp_heartyflatbread_desc: Crispy, hearty and good for the road.
vfp_feastbog_desc: Smells of the bog. Everyone eats anyway.
vfp_feastharvest_desc: Enough for a whole village. Or three hungry vikings.
vfp_feastnorthernlights_desc: Warms belly and soul when everything outside freezes.
